song.name: Battle for Soul
song.plot: Internal schism in the Covenant. Fanatical vampires want to surrender their soul-banks to awaken Nyktoros as a god, while Acheron fights to keep the energy locked and maintain their independence.
song.analysis: The original is a generic "good vs evil battle" piece built on filler ("a fearsome view", "a darkness falls", "a force of good"). The reworked version anchors it to the actual arc (~180 BGD): the internal schism, zealots wanting to unseal the vaults to awaken Nyktoros, Acheron purging them with his blade of starlight steel and locking the vaults tight, foreshadowing the dark Tome's disposal. Uniform 8-8-8-8 meter. Suggested song direction: conflicted, dramatic, ideological — clashing strings and war drums, angular minor-key riffing, tense standoff energy.
